category_title: Students with mild intellectual disability capable of logical leadership roles
minimal_context: Ben is working on a group mind-mapping task on Google Drive to define emotion.
dialogue:
TUTOR: Let's start making our mind map on Google Drive to define what emotion is today. Ben, you will be jotting down the key points for the group.

STUDENT: HAPPY.

TUTOR: Okay, that is one point. As we prepare the rest of the mind map and the PowerPoint, what difficulties might you encounter?

STUDENT: Need to work hard.

TUTOR: Yes, it will take some effort. What else?

STUDENT: Typing... rest... feeling nervous...

options.A: Establish, through consensus, the working practices of the group via a small group pledge, and reinforce it over time.
options.B: Ask follow-up questions during the group mind-mapping discussions to model conversational skills for the student.
options.C: Introduce research skills and how to use computers (Google Drive) during subject teaching (e.g., Chinese) rather than separate computer lessons.
options.D: Use a visual schedule that identifies the activities of the day and the reinforcers the student is eligible to receive.
